defects.canonical: The capacity check (len(self._items) >= self._capacity) and the append are in separate critical sections: the lock is released at the end of the `with self._lock` block before `self._items.append(item)` runs unlocked. Two concurrent puts that both observe size == capacity-1 inside the lock can both pass the check, both release, and both append, leaving the buffer at capacity+1 and violating the fixed-capacity invariant.
defects.why_subtle: Every line individually looks locked and correct; the bug is that the append sits just outside the `with self._lock` block, so the check and the append are not one atomic operation.
